messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

The 5 mg tablet is white to off-white and contains no color additives. The 7.5 mg and 10 mg tablets also contain FD&C Blue #1 Aluminum Lake. The 12.5 mg, 15 mg, 20 mg, and 30 mg tablets also contain FD&C Yellow #6 Aluminum Lake.
Triplet: ["Adderall", "has tablet color additive", "FD&C Blue #1 Aluminum Lake"]

The relation 'has tablet color additive' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug's tablet contains the color additive specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'passes into': The subject drug is transferred or present in the substance or medium specified by the object entity.
B. 'has effect': The subject drug produces the therapeutic or physiological effect specified by the object entity.
C. None of the above.
